result_preview.shortDescription: REST API for querying and updating real-time contact engagement state within active customer journeys.
result_preview.description: Exposes real-time contact state data for customers currently enrolled in active journeys, including engagement metrics, journey step progress, and interaction history. Enables external systems to query contact journey status, update custom attributes mid-journey, and trigger journey state changes based on external events. Essential for omnichannel orchestration and real-time personalization decisions.

result_preview.shortDescription: Retrieves and synchronizes customer touchpoint data across marketing campaigns and multi-channel communications.
result_preview.description: Exposes customer interaction records and engagement metadata from campaigns to support dynamic orchestration of personalized marketing experiences. Facilitates unified view of customer communications to drive consistent omnichannel messaging and campaign performance optimization.
